biography:
== Biography ==
Margaretha Schmidt was born in Germany on 18 November 1856, the daughter of Conrad Schmidt.<ref name="fag_margaretha">Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/133020303/margaretha-hohn : accessed 17 November 2026), memorial 133020303, Margaretha Hohn (18 Nov 1856-27 May 1906), All Faiths Cemetery, Middle Village, Queens, New York; gravestone photograph by Lisa F. (inscription: "meine geliebte Gattin Margaretha Höhn ... und Sohn Adam Höhn").</ref><ref name="d1906margaret">"Certificate and Record of Death", no. 2762 (1906), Borough of the Bronx, Margaret Hoehn, 27 May 1906; New York City Municipal Archives, Historical Vital Records (https://a860-historicalvitalrecords.nyc.gov/view/4125958 : accessed 17 November 2026); image D-B-1906-0002762. Age 49 y 6 m 9 d; married; born Germany; father Conrad Schmidt; died 629 E. 154th St.; buried Lutheran Cemetery 29 May 1906.</ref> About 1876 she married Jacob Höhn (Hohn).<ref name="c1900hohn">"1900 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7602/records/66919373 : accessed 17 November 2026), Jacob Hohn household, 833 First Avenue, Manhattan, New York, New York; enumeration district (ED) 589, sheet 7, lines 93-96; NARA microfilm publication T623, roll 1107. Daughter indexed as "Horn Hohn" (name and relationship columns transposed on the image; she is "Annie", daughter).</ref> Their son Adam was born in Germany on 30 November 1875, and their daughter Anna about February 1883–84.<ref name="fag_adam">Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/133020376/adam-hohn : accessed 17 November 2026), memorial 133020376, Adam Hohn (30 Nov 1875-5 Jul 1902), All Faiths Cemetery, Middle Village, Queens, New York.</ref><ref name="m1911cert">"Certificate and Record of Marriage", no. 1449 (1911), Borough of the Bronx, Alfred Benjamin Bigg Jr. and Anna Hohn, 17 Jun 1911; New York City Municipal Archives, Historical Vital Records (https://a860-historicalvitalrecords.nyc.gov/view/8892418 : accessed 17 November 2026); image M-B-1911-0001449. Bride age 27, born New York City; father Jacob Hohn; mother's maiden name Margaret Schmidt; bride signs "Anna Hohn".</ref> The family came to New York about 1883–84. A "Mary Hohn", 26, arrived with Jacob, 32, and Adam, 8, on the ''Rhynland'' on 10 August 1883; this is probably the same family.<ref name="ship1883">"New York, U.S., Arriving Passenger and Crew Lists (including Castle Garden and Ellis Island), 1820-1957", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7488/records/11769566 : accessed 17 November 2026), Jacob Hohn, 32, with Mary Hohn, 26, and Adam Hohn, 8; ship Rhynland, Antwerp to New York, arrived 10 Aug 1883; NARA microfilm publication M237, roll 469.</ref>

In 1900 Margaret lived with Jacob, Adam and Annie at 833 First Avenue, Manhattan. She was the mother of two children, both then living.<ref name="c1900hohn" /> Adam died in 1902. Margaretha died at home at 629 East 154th Street in the Bronx on 27 May 1906, of heart disease and nephritis, aged 49.<ref name="d1906margaret" /> She was buried on 29 May in the Lutheran (now All Faiths) Cemetery in Middle Village, Queens, beside Adam. Her gravestone reads "meine geliebte Gattin Margaretha Höhn".<ref name="fag_margaretha" /> Her daughter Anna gave her mother's maiden name as Margaret Schmidt when she married in 1911.<ref name="m1911cert" />

=== Research Notes ===
* Her mother's name is blank on her death certificate. Her German birthplace is not yet known.
